items.lede: President Trump has called for Jensen Huang to return as Nvidia CEO, but a new report says the board is not considering the move.
items.title: Trump calls for Jensen Huang reinstatement as Nvidia CEO

items.lede: A number of tech figures want the board of the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
items.title: Trump backs return of ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign launched
